name: Family C
definition: Implication-closure of equation 43 (commutativity) in Tao et al.'s Equational Theories Project (ETP).
closure_verification: Computed via ETP's 22M-entry implication graph. See trinity-infinity-geometry/etp_database/scripts/verify_family_c.py
structural_interpretation: 12 commutativity-derived equations + reflexivity + the commutativity axiom. Each derived equation is obtained by applying commutativity at a single position in an expression of depth ≤ 3 (the '1-step deductive closure' of commutativity in ETP's depth-3 enumeration scheme).
uniqueness_claim: Family C is the unique commutative-magma equational profile of size 14 at orders 3 and 5 (theorem, by exhaustive enumeration). Conjecturally unique at all orders ≥ 5.

smallest_known.note: Lex-first commutative non-associative 3x3 magma satisfying exactly the Family C 14 equations. Verified by find_smallest_family_c_realizer.py. There are 120 such order-3 realizers total.
